# Toronto Cookies

> Corporate and holiday cookie gifting concierge for Toronto offices. We source gourmet, nut-free and custom logo cookies from licensed Toronto bakeries and deliver to every recipient. We do not bake or handle food ourselves.

Key facts:
- Single holiday cookie gift box delivered in Toronto: $59 CAD
- Office holiday cookie tray (24-30 cookies): $129 CAD
- Client Gift Pack, 10 boxes to 10 Toronto addresses with cards: $590 CAD
- Custom logo cookies: bakery quote + 20% concierge fee, minimum $79 CAD
- City of Toronto delivery included; rest of GTA quoted
- 2026 holiday deadline: order by Wednesday, December 9, 2026 for delivery by Friday, December 18, 2026
- Payment by card via Stripe after the order is confirmed; nothing is ordered before payment

- [Office Holiday Cookie Tray](https://torontocookies.ca/office-cookie-tray-toronto/): A shareable tray of 24 to 30 fresh cookies for the office, the holiday party, or a client meeting, delivered to your Toronto office.
- [Client Gift Pack (10 boxes)](https://torontocookies.ca/client-cookie-gift-pack-toronto/): Ten holiday cookie gift boxes sent to ten different Toronto addresses, each with its own card. Send us a list; we handle the rest.
- [Custom Logo Cookies](https://torontocookies.ca/logo-cookies-toronto/): Cookies printed or hand-decorated with your company logo, sourced from a Toronto logo-cookie specialist. We quote the bakery's price plus a 20% concierge fee, minimum $79.
